The '''Ojoster sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], adjacent to the [[Mandalore sector/Legends|Mandalore sector]]. [[Planet/Legends|Planets]] in the Ojoster Sector included [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]], [[Denova]] and [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. The sector's local government was the [[Ojoster Sector Assembly]].
